description:
A feed, briefed. Every minute it reads the feed it was given; any article it has not read before is fetched, read by a language model, and given a short brief written to be heard rather than read. What it publishes is the same feed again, with the brief where the feed's own line was.

An article appears in what it publishes **only once its brief is written**, so whatever reads that feed never sees an article before the editor has. That is the whole of its contract with the radio: the radio reads a feed, as it always did, and this one happens to say something worth hearing.

Three things in its pipeline are worth reading closely. **The claim** is one SQL statement that takes an article it has not seen or hands back nothing, so an article already taken stops its own pass. **Two detours** — the page, then the brief — each go off and come back *beside* the article rather than instead of it, which is how the brief still knows which article it belongs to. And **a failure is recorded, not retried**: a page that cannot be read or fetched is noted, and the model briefs from the title and the feed's line alone; a brief that fails is kept on the desk with the reason the model or the API gave, and waits for a person — **Retry** runs that one article again, **Use the feed's line** publishes it with the line its feed gave it. A brief that started and never finished counts as failed after `stuckAfter`.

The model is Claude on hkp-node's `anthropic` backend, with the key from `{{secret.anthropic.key}}` in Settings → Secrets. A key that names a secret is that secret or nothing: hkp-node reads no key from its environment. To brief with a local model instead, set the `backend` param to `server`, `serverUrl` to an OpenAI-compatible server, and `apiKey` to empty (or to the token that server wants).

Needs hkp-node, kept as the remote `node`.

params.feedDescription: Each article with a short brief, written to be heard

state.schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brief (
  guid       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  link       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  title      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  blurb      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  feed       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  published  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  seen       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  started    TEXT,
  failed     TEXT,
  error      TEXT,
  page_error TEXT,
  brief      TEXT,
  source     TEXT,
  written    TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS brief_link ON brief(link);
state.statement:
INSERT INTO brief (guid, link, title, blurb, feed, published, started)
VALUES ($guid, IFNULL($link, ''), IFNULL($title, ''), IFNULL($summary, ''),
        IFNULL($feed, ''), IFNULL($published, ''), datetime('now'))
ON CONFLICT(guid) DO UPDATE
   SET started = datetime('now'), failed = NULL, error = NULL, page_error = NULL
 WHERE $retry = 1 AND brief.written IS NULL
RETURNING guid, title, link, blurb

template.=: params.meta.status === 200 && params.body ? params : 'The article could not be read.'

template.prompt=:
'Title: ' + params.title + '

The feed says: ' + withoutUrls(params.blurb) + '

The article:
' + (params.page.text || 'The article could not be read.')

state.systemPrompt: You write the brief a radio presenter reads after an article's title. Say what the article reports or argues and why it matters, in two to four plain sentences and at most 80 words. It will be heard, not read: no markdown, lists, headings, links or quotation marks, and do not open with the title or with phrases like 'This article'. Use only what the text gives you. When the article text is missing or is not the article (an error page, a paywall, a cookie notice), work from the title and the feed's line alone and say less rather than guess.

state.statement:
UPDATE brief
   SET brief      = $brief,
       source     = CASE WHEN $brief IS NOT NULL THEN 'model' END,
       written    = CASE WHEN $brief IS NOT NULL THEN datetime('now') END,
       failed     = CASE WHEN $brief IS NULL THEN datetime('now') END,
       error      = CASE WHEN $brief IS NULL THEN IFNULL($error, 'the brief came back empty') END,
       page_error = $pageError
 WHERE guid = $guid

state.statement:
SELECT guid, title, link, feed, blurb, published,
       IFNULL(brief, '') AS brief,
       CASE
         WHEN written IS NOT NULL AND source = 'feed'
           THEN 'The feed''s own line, chosen ' || written
         WHEN written IS NOT NULL AND page_error IS NOT NULL
           THEN 'Briefed ' || written || ' from the title and the feed''s line — the page: ' || page_error
         WHEN written IS NOT NULL THEN 'Briefed ' || written
         WHEN failed IS NOT NULL THEN 'Failed: ' || IFNULL(error, 'no reason given')
         WHEN started < datetime('now', '{{param.stuckAfter}}')
           THEN 'Failed: no answer since ' || started
         ELSE 'Briefing… since ' || started
       END AS status,
       CASE WHEN written IS NULL
             AND (failed IS NOT NULL OR started < datetime('now', '{{param.stuckAfter}}'))
            THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS settled
  FROM brief
 ORDER BY seen DESC
 LIMIT 50

briefs.serviceName: The briefed articles as a feed

state.schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brief (
  guid       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  link       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  title      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  blurb      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  feed       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  published  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  seen       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  started    TEXT,

);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS brief_link ON brief(link);
state.statement:
SELECT '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>'
    || '<rss version="2.0"><channel>'
    || '<title><![CDATA[' || replace(IFNULL($channelTitle, ''), ']]>', ']]>') || ']]></title>'
    || '<link>' || replace(replace(replace(IFNULL($channelLink, ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>') || '</link>'
    || '<description><![CDATA[' || replace(IFNULL($channelDescription, ''), ']]>', ']]>') || ']]></description>'
    || IFNULL(group_concat(item, '' ORDER BY sortKey DESC), '')
    || '</channel></rss>' AS feed
  FROM (
    SELECT '<item>'
        || '<title><![CDATA[' || replace(IFNULL(title, ''), ']]>', ']]>') || ']]></title>'
        || '<link>' || replace(replace(replace(IFNULL(link, ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>') || '</link>'
        || '<guid isPermaLink="false">' || replace(replace(replace(guid, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>') || '</guid>'
        || '<pubDate>' || IFNULL(published, '') || '</pubDate>'
        || '<category><![CDATA[' || replace(IFNULL(feed, ''), ']]>', ']]>') || ']]></category>'
        || '<description><![CDATA[' || replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(brief, ''), blurb, ''), ']]>', ']]>') || ']]></description>'
        || '</item>' AS item,
           seen AS sortKey
      FROM brief
     WHERE written IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY seen DESC
     LIMIT 100
  )

items.placeholder: Every article the editor has taken from its feed, newest first, and where it is: being briefed, briefed, or failed — with the reason. It checks the feed every minute by itself. A failed brief waits for you: try it again, or publish it with the line its feed gave it.
